newsitem.title: UK: Both Brent cargoes kept by Elf - traders.
newsitem.headline: Both Brent cargoes kept by Elf - traders.

text.p: Both of the Brent cargoes loading July 22-24 and turning wet from the paper chains on Monday were kept by French refiner Elf, traders said.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market, until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a cargo which has changed from paper to physical at the deadline and therefore can no longer be passed on as part of pre-sold paper chains.
